repos.description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and 550+ data providers through one API.

repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
repos.summary_zh: 微软开源Python工具，将Office文档、PDF、音视频等30+格式转换为Markdown。专为LLM和文本分析管道设计，保留标题、列表、表格等结构，输出token高效。集成OCR、语音转录、YouTube下载等能力，提供MCP服务器供Claude等LLM应用调用。流式处理无临时文件，插件化架构支持扩展。
repos.summary_en: Microsoft's open-source Python utility converts 30+ file formats (Office documents, PDF, images, audio, HTML, etc.) to Markdown for LLM and text analysis pipelines. Preserves document structure—headings, lists, tables, links—with token-efficient output. Integrates OCR, speech transcription, YouTube processing, and MCP server for Claude/LLM integration. Stream-based processing eliminates temporary files; plugin architecture enables custom converters.

repos.description: A collection of DESIGN.md files analysis by popular brand design systems. Drop one into your project and let coding agents generate a matching UI.
repos.summary_zh: 精选55+个知名网站的DESIGN.md设计系统文档，为AI编码代理提供纯文本规范以生成像素级完美UI。完整定义视觉主题、色彩、排版、组件样式及响应式行为，无需Figma或JSON等复杂工具，显著提升AI驱动前端开发的效率与一致性。
repos.summary_en: A curated collection of 55+ DESIGN.md files from popular websites, capturing complete design systems in plain text. Enables AI coding agents to generate pixel-perfect UIs by defining visual themes, colors, typography, components, and responsive behavior. Eliminates Figma exports or JSON schemas, streamlining AI-powered frontend development with LLM-friendly markdown format.

repos.description: Turn any PDF or image document into structured data for your AI. A powerful, lightweight OCR toolkit that bridges the gap between images/PDFs and LLMs. Supports 100+ languages.
repos.summary_zh: PaddleOCR 是基于 PaddlePaddle 的工业级 OCR 工具包，支持 100+ 语言的多模态文档解析。核心亮点包括端到端 pipeline、轻量级部署、多硬件加速（CPU/GPU/XPU/NPU），以及专为 LLM 优化的结构化数据输出。适用于文档数字化、表单识别、票据处理等 AI 应用场景，提供从图像到结构化数据的无缝桥梁。
repos.summary_en: PaddleOCR is an industrial-grade OCR toolkit powered by PaddlePaddle, designed for high-performance document intelligence. It supports 100+ languages and multimodal inputs (images/PDFs), delivering end-to-end text detection, recognition, and structure analysis. Key technical advantages include lightweight deployment, multi-hardware acceleration (CPU/GPU/XPU/NPU), and LLM-optimized structured outputs. Ideal for document digitization, form processing, invoice extraction, and AI-driven data pipelines, it seamlessly converts unstructured visual content into machine-readable formats for downstream applications requiring precise text extraction and semantic understanding.

repos.description: Official Crawl4AI Cloud: a hosted web scraping, extraction, and search API for AI agents. Free API key, 1,000 credits a month, no card. Fully open source: this repo is the Apache-2.0 crawler that powers it, and you can self-host it.
repos.summary_zh: Crawl4AI 是一款开源的LLM友好型网页爬虫，专为RAG、AI代理和数据管道设计。它将网页转换为干净的Markdown格式，便于大语言模型处理。项目亮点包括：崩溃恢复机制支持长时间深度爬取；预取模式提升5-10倍URL发现速度；提供自托管平台，含企业级监控仪表板和REST API；采用浏览器池管理技术。拥有5万+星标社区验证，相比现有方案显著降低成本，支持完全本地化部署。
repos.summary_en: Crawl4AI is an open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler designed for RAG, AI agents, and data pipelines. It converts web content into clean Markdown format optimized for language models. Key features include crash recovery for long-running deep crawls, prefetch mode for 5-10x faster URL discovery, and a self-hosting platform with enterprise-grade monitoring dashboard, REST API, and WebSocket streaming. Battle-tested by a 50k+ star community, it offers a cost-effective alternative to paid solutions with full local deployment capabilities and smart browser pool management.

repos.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 45 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
repos.summary_zh: 专为Claude Code、Codex、Pi等AI智能体打造的编辑级图表技能。输出纯自包含HTML+SVG，无阴影、无Mermaid粗糙样式，支持架构、流程、序列、Sankey、Wardley等数十种专业类型。可读取网站自动匹配品牌色与字体，默认静态输出，可选无障碍动画，并能重绘draw.io/Mermaid/Excalidraw源图。强调极简密度与焦点设计，让AI生成图表真正达到设计师水准。
repos.summary_en: Editorial diagram skill for Claude Code, Codex, Pi and Agent Skills hosts. Produces self-contained HTML+SVG with no shadows or Mermaid-style clutter. Supports architecture, flowcharts, sequences, Sankey, Wardley maps and dozens more types. Auto-matches brand colors/fonts from your site in seconds. Static by default with optional accessible motion; redraws draw.io, Mermaid or Excalidraw sources. Delivers clean, designer-approved visuals with deliberate low density and focal accents.

repos.description: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个专为AI编码代理设计的营销技能集合，以Markdown文件形式提供CRO、文案写作、SEO、数据分析和增长工程等专业工作流。基于Agent Skills规范构建，技能相互引用并以product-marketing为基础，提供产品、受众与定位上下文。适用于Claude Code、Cursor等工具，帮助技术营销者和创始人通过AI代理实现营销任务自动化与优化。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a curated collection of markdown-based skills for AI coding agents, specializing in CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering. Built to the Agent Skills spec, skills interconnect with product-marketing as the foundational layer providing product, audience, and positioning context. It empowers technical marketers and founders using Claude Code, Cursor, and similar agents to automate and optimize marketing workflows efficiently.

repos.description: 坚持分享 GitHub 上高质量、有趣实用的开源技术教程、开发者工具、编程网站、技术资讯。A list cool, interesting projects of GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: GitHubDaily 是一个运营近十年的开源项目策展平台，累计分享超10000个高质量开源项目。通过GitHub仓库、公众号、微博等多渠道，系统化推荐技术教程、开发者工具与行业资讯，核心价值在于从海量项目中筛选高价值内容，并按AI工具、开发工具等维度结构化整理，助力开发者拓展技术视野与提升编程能力。
repos.summary_en: GitHubDaily is a decade-old open source curation platform that has shared over 10,000 high-quality projects. Through multiple channels including GitHub, WeChat, and Twitter, it systematically recommends technical tutorials, developer tools, and industry insights. Its core value lies in filtering high-value content from massive repositories and organizing it into structured categories like AI tools and development utilities, helping developers expand technical horizons and enhance programming skills.

repos.description: [EMNLP 2025 Demo] PDF scientific paper translation with preserved formats - 基于 AI 完整保留排版的 PDF 文档全文双语翻译，支持 Google/DeepL/Ollama/OpenAI 等服务，提供 CLI/GUI/MCP/Docker/Zotero
repos.summary_zh: PDFMathTranslate 是一款专注于科技文献的PDF翻译工具，核心优势在于完整保留原始排版。支持公式、图表、目录、注释等复杂元素的精准定位与翻译。集成Google、DeepL、Ollama、OpenAI等多引擎，提供CLI、GUI、Docker及Zotero插件等多种使用方式。适用于学术研究、论文阅读等场景，支持多语言互译，确保学术文档的专业性与可读性。
repos.summary_en: PDFMathTranslate is a specialized PDF translation tool for scientific documents that preserves original layouts with high fidelity. It accurately handles complex elements including formulas, charts, tables of contents, and annotations. The tool integrates multiple translation backends such as Google, DeepL, Ollama, and OpenAI, offering flexible deployment via CLI, GUI, Docker, and Zotero plugins. Designed for academic research and paper reading, it supports multilingual translation while maintaining the professional quality and readability of scholarly documents.

repos.description: PDF Parser for AI-ready data. Automate PDF accessibility. Open-source.
repos.summary_zh: OpenDataLoader PDF 是开源 PDF 解析器，专注 AI 就绪数据提取与 PDF 无障碍自动化。支持 PDF 转 Markdown、带边界框 JSON 和 HTML，基准测试整体准确率 0.907、表格 0.928 排名第一。采用确定性本地模式 + 混合 AI/OCR 模式，处理多栏、扫描文档、复杂表格。提供 Python/Node.js/Java SDK，首创开源端到端自动标记生成 Tagged PDF，支持 PDF/UA 合规。适用于 RAG/LLM 管道与无障碍合规场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenDataLoader PDF is an open-source PDF parser focused on AI-ready data extraction and PDF accessibility automation. It converts PDFs to Markdown, JSON with bounding boxes, and HTML, ranking #1 in benchmarks with 0.907 overall and 0.928 table accuracy. Features deterministic local mode plus hybrid AI/OCR for multi-column layouts, scanned docs, and complex tables. Offers Python, Node.js, and Java SDKs; first open-source end-to-end auto-tagging to Tagged PDF for PDF/UA compliance. Ideal for RAG/LLM pipelines and accessibility remediation.

repos.description: A format specification for describing a visual identity to coding agents. DESIGN.md gives agents a persistent, structured understanding of a design system.
repos.summary_zh: DESIGN.md 是 Google Labs 开源的视觉身份描述格式规范，专为编码代理设计。通过 YAML 前置元数据定义设计令牌（颜色、排版、间距等），结合 Markdown 散文阐述设计理念，提供持久结构化的设计系统理解。核心价值确保 AI 生成 UI 的一致性与准确性。适用于 AI 辅助前端开发、设计系统跨工具迁移场景。技术亮点融合机器可读令牌与人类可读说明，支持 lint 校验 WCAG 对比、版本 diff 等工具。
repos.summary_en: DESIGN.md is a Google Labs open-sourced format specification for describing visual identities to coding agents. It combines YAML front matter for machine-readable design tokens (colors, typography, spacing) with Markdown prose explaining the rationale. This provides agents with a persistent, structured understanding of design systems for consistent UI generation. Ideal for AI-assisted frontend development and design system portability. Key highlights include WCAG contrast linting, version diffing, token references, and the hybrid machine-human readable format.

repos.description: A modern ebook manager and reader with sync and backup capacities for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS and Web
repos.summary_zh: Koodo Reader 是一款开源的跨平台电子书阅读管理工具，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 及 Web 全平台。核心亮点包括：支持 EPUB、PDF、MOBI 等 15+ 格式，集成 OneDrive、Google Drive 等 10+ 云存储实现数据同步，内置 AI 词典翻译与文本朗读功能，提供丰富的阅读自定义选项，是个人数字阅读管理的理想解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Koodo Reader is an open-source, cross-platform ebook management and reading application supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and Web. Key features include: compatibility with 15+ formats including EPUB, PDF, and MOBI; seamless synchronization via 10+ cloud services like OneDrive and Google Drive; integrated AI-powered dictionary, translation and text-to-speech; extensive customization for fonts, themes and layouts. It provides a comprehensive solution for personal digital reading management across all devices.

repos.description: Fast Rust library for PDF inspection, classification, and text extraction. Intelligently detects scanned vs text-based PDFs to enable smart routing decisions.
repos.summary_zh: Firecrawl出品的高性能Rust库，智能识别PDF类型（文本/扫描/混合），自动跳过54%无需OCR的文档。200ms内完成文本提取、多列布局识别、表格检测，输出结构化Markdown。纯Rust实现，比OCR方案快数个量级，适合大规模PDF处理场景。
repos.summary_en: A high-performance Rust library by Firecrawl that intelligently classifies PDFs (text-based/scanned/mixed) to bypass OCR for ~54% of documents. Processes text extraction, multi-column layouts, and table detection in under 200ms, outputting structured Markdown. Pure Rust implementation delivers orders of magnitude faster performance than OCR-based solutions, ideal for large-scale PDF processing.

repos.description: Chinese copywriting guidelines for better written communication／中文文案排版指北
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供全面的中文文案排版规范，系统性地统一中英文、数字间的空格规则，规范标点符号使用、全半角字符标准，以及专有名词正确大小写。旨在降低团队协作沟通成本，提升内容质量和网站专业气质。包含丰富实用示例和争议性案例讨论，并集成pangu.js等自动化工具实现规则检查。适用于网站、文档、UI界面等所有中文内容创作场景，是开发者、设计师和内容创作者的标准化必备参考指南。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides comprehensive Chinese copywriting and typesetting guidelines, standardizing spacing between Chinese/English characters and numbers, proper punctuation usage, and correct capitalization. It aims to reduce team communication costs and enhance content quality. Includes practical examples, controversial edge cases, and integrates automation tools like pangu.js for rule enforcement. Essential for developers, designers, and content creators working with Chinese language content across websites, documentation, and UI interfaces.

repos.description: Capture first. Organize later. A local-first Markdown app that turns scattered records into clear notes with AI.
repos.summary_zh: NoteGen是一款轻量级(25MB)跨平台Markdown笔记应用，深度融合AI智能能力，原生支持RAG检索增强与MCP协议，能够智能桥接碎片化记录与结构化写作，实现知识高效组织与管理。
repos.summary_en: Lightweight (25MB) cross-platform Markdown note app with AI, RAG and MCP support for intelligent knowledge organization.

repos.description: OCR model that handles complex tables, forms, handwriting with full layout.
repos.summary_zh: Chandra OCR 2 是业界领先的文档智能模型，专精于复杂表格、手写体及数学公式的精准识别。支持90+语言，完美保留原始布局，输出HTML/Markdown/JSON结构化数据。提供本地(HuggingFace)与云端(vLLM)双模式，在手写表单、技术文档等场景表现卓越，是企业级文档自动化的核心引擎。
repos.summary_en: Chandra OCR 2 is a state-of-the-art document intelligence model excelling at complex tables, handwriting, and mathematical formulas. Supporting 90+ languages, it preserves full layout fidelity while outputting structured HTML/Markdown/JSON. With dual inference modes (local HuggingFace and remote vLLM), it delivers exceptional performance for forms, technical documents, and multilingual content, serving as a core engine for enterprise document automation.

repos.description: PDF craft can convert PDF files into various other formats. This project will focus on processing PDF files of scanned books.
repos.summary_zh: PDF Craft 是基于 DeepSeek OCR 的本地 PDF 转换工具，专注于扫描书籍的数字化处理。支持 GPU 加速，可将 PDF 转换为 Markdown 或 EPUB 格式，自动识别文档结构、提取正文、过滤页眉页脚，并正确处理表格、公式和脚注。v1.0.0 后完全本地化，无需网络请求，性能显著提升。
repos.summary_en: PDF Craft is a high-performance local PDF conversion tool built on DeepSeek OCR technology, specifically designed for digitizing scanned books and documents. The tool leverages GPU acceleration to efficiently convert PDF files into structured Markdown or EPUB formats while preserving document integrity. Key features include automatic document structure recognition, intelligent extraction of main text content, removal of interfering elements like headers and footers, and proper handling of complex elements such as tables, mathematical formulas, and footnotes. Starting from version 1.0.0, PDF Craft operates entirely offline without network dependencies, eliminating previous limitations of LLM-based text correction while delivering substantially improved conversion speed and reliability for academic and technical documents.

repos.description: 赫蹏（hètí）是专为中文内容展示设计的排版样式增强。它基于通行的中文排版规范而来，可以为网站的读者带来更好的文章阅读体验。
repos.summary_zh: 赫蹏是专为中文网页内容设计的排版增强库，基于现代CSS与JavaScript实现。它提供网格对齐、中西文混排自动美化、标点挤压、竖排古文诗词版式等特性，支持简繁体与黑暗模式。通过简单的类名引入即可显著提升中文阅读体验，兼容主流样式重置方案，适配移动端。
repos.summary_en: Heti is a specialized typography enhancement library designed for Chinese web content presentation, implemented with modern CSS and JavaScript. It delivers grid-aligned layout, automatic Chinese-Western text spacing, punctuation compression, pre-configured layouts for classical texts and poetry, vertical writing support, and seamless dark mode adaptation. The library supports both simplified and traditional Chinese while being fully responsive for mobile devices. With simple class name integration, it dramatically elevates Chinese reading experience and is compatible with popular CSS reset solutions.

repos.description: 把 Markdown 一键排成可直接粘进公众号编辑器的精致 HTML —— 6 套精选主题 + 主题生成器 + 双关卡校验。An AI-agent skill that turns Markdown into paste-ready WeChat article HTML.
repos.summary_zh: gzh-design-skill 是一个专为 AI Agent 设计的公众号排版技能，将 Markdown 一键转为微信编辑器兼容的内联 HTML。内置 6 套精选主题及主题生成器，支持自动章节编号、关键词下划线、代码块图片 GIF 处理，并通过 Python 双重校验脚本确保质量。适用于教程测评、深度分析、数据报告等场景，规避平台格式限制，实现确定性高质量输出，提升内容创作效率。
repos.summary_en: gzh-design-skill is an AI-agent skill that converts Markdown into paste-ready, inline-styled HTML optimized for the WeChat public account editor. It features 6 curated themes, a theme generator, automatic chapter numbering, keyword highlighting, code block/image/GIF support, and dual Python validation scripts. Ideal for tutorials, reviews, analyses, and reports, it ensures WeChat compatibility and deterministic quality for agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.

repos.description: List of 67 awesome DESIGN.md and SKILL.md design skill files for agentic tools like Claude Design, Google Stitch, Codex, Cursor, and other AI tools
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库为Claude Code、Cursor等AI编程助手提供67个结构化设计系统技能文件。每个技能包含SKILL.md（AI可读的组件规范、可访问性约束、质量标准）和DESIGN.md（人类可读的设计意图）。通过TypeUI CLI一键集成，确保AI生成UI符合品牌规范、设计一致性与WCAG 2.2 AA标准，实现AI辅助开发中设计质量与效率的质的飞跃。
repos.summary_en: A curated registry of 67 design system skill files specifically engineered for AI coding agents including Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. Each skill delivers structured instructions via SKILL.md (machine-readable component rules, accessibility constraints, quality gates) and DESIGN.md (human-readable rationale and maintenance notes). The TypeUI CLI enables one-command integration directly into projects, ensuring AI-generated UIs automatically adhere to brand guidelines, design consistency, and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance. This fundamentally transforms AI-assisted development by embedding design system intelligence into agent workflows, enabling rapid prototyping at scale while maintaining human oversight and quality control.

repos.description: AGENTS.md rules / skills for AI coding agents: Codex, Cursor & Claude Code. Inspired by Clean Code, Refactoring, DDD, Clean Architecture and DDIA programming books.
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库将经典软件工程著作（如Clean Code、DDD、DDIA）提炼为AI编程智能体（Cursor、Claude Code、Codex）可执行的规则集。提供full/mini/nano三版本适配不同上下文窗口，注入工程化思维与架构治理，提升AI生成代码的质量与可维护性。
repos.summary_en: This repository distills classic software engineering books (Clean Code, DDD, DDIA) into executable rule sets for AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex). It provides three versions (full/mini/nano) to fit different context windows, injecting engineering mindset and architecture governance into AI-generated code. The tool-agnostic Markdown format enhances code quality and maintainability while supporting editor-specific configurations for optimal AI-assisted development.

repos.description: Enhances Tesseract OCR output using LLMs (local or API) for error correction, smart chunking, and markdown formatting of scanned PDFs
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过LLM增强传统OCR流程，显著提升扫描PDF的识别准确率与可读性。核心采用Tesseract进行基础OCR识别，再利用本地或API大模型进行智能纠错、分块与Markdown格式化。支持异步处理与GPU加速，适用于文档数字化、档案管理等场景，有效解决OCR常见错误与格式混乱问题。
repos.summary_en: This project enhances traditional OCR pipelines using LLMs to significantly improve accuracy and readability of scanned PDFs. It employs Tesseract for base OCR, then leverages local or API-based LLMs for intelligent error correction, smart chunking, and Markdown formatting. Key features include asynchronous processing, GPU acceleration for local inference, and flexible hybrid deployment. Designed for document digitization, archival management, and office automation, it effectively resolves common OCR errors, duplicate content, and formatting inconsistencies while preserving document structure.

repos.description: Your Self-Hosted Knowledge Base
repos.summary_zh: NoteDiscovery 是一款轻量级自托管笔记与知识库应用，强调数据隐私与所有权。采用纯 Markdown 文件存储，支持知识图谱可视化、LaTeX 数学、Mermaid 图表、内置绘图编辑器及插件扩展。通过 MCP 协议实现与 Claude、Cursor 等 AI 助手的深度集成，支持笔记搜索、创建与组织。提供美观响应式界面、可选认证和多语言支持，是 Notion、Obsidian 的免费开源替代方案，适合开发者、知识工作者及隐私敏感用户，Docker 一键部署，无订阅费用与厂商锁定。
repos.summary_en: NoteDiscovery is a lightweight self-hosted note-taking and knowledge base application that empowers users with full control over their data. Notes are stored as plain Markdown files, featuring an elegant web UI with graph visualization, LaTeX/MathJax support, Mermaid diagrams, a drawing editor, and extensive customization via themes and plugins. It stands out with MCP integration for AI tools like Claude and Cursor, enabling direct note search, creation, and organization. Responsive across devices with optional auth and multi-language support, it serves as a free, open-source alternative to Notion or Obsidian for privacy-focused developers and knowledge workers, with effortless Docker deployment and zero subscriptions or lock-in.

repos.description: 🌩️ Serverless 自托管的文件管理与文本分享工具/网盘，支持多存储聚合管理和WebDAV 服务挂载。兼容 S3、WebDAV、OneDrive、Google Drive、Telegram、HF、GitHub 等。内置   Markdown 编辑器、30+文件格式预览。支持 Cloudflare Workers 或 Docker 部署。
repos.summary_zh: CloudPaste 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Serverless 自托管网盘，核心价值在于多云存储聚合管理与零运维部署。支持 S3、OneDrive、Google Drive 等 30+ 存储后端，提供统一 WebDAV 挂载。内置 Vditor Markdown 编辑器与 30+ 文件格式预览，实现个人知识库管理与团队协作。通过边缘计算实现全球加速，Docker 部署提供本地灵活性。
repos.summary_en: CloudPaste is a Serverless self-hosted cloud storage built on Cloudflare Workers, aggregating 30+ storage backends including S3, OneDrive, and Google Drive with unified WebDAV mounting. It features a Vditor Markdown editor, 30+ file format previews, and edge computing acceleration across 300+ global nodes. Offering zero-maintenance deployment via Workers or Docker, it serves as an ideal solution for personal knowledge management and team collaboration.

repos.description: AI Agent Skill to generate and render beautiful Mermaid diagrams as SVG or terminal ASCII — 15 themes, 6 diagram types, batch CLI, no browser.
repos.summary_zh: 专为AI Agent设计的Mermaid图表渲染技能，本地无浏览器生成精美SVG/PNG/终端ASCII，支持15主题、6种图类型（流程图/时序/状态/类/ER/XY）与批量CLI，无缝集成Claude Code、Cursor等环境。
repos.summary_en: AI Agent skill for rendering beautiful Mermaid diagrams locally without a browser. Outputs themed SVG, PNG, or terminal ASCII/Unicode. Supports 15 themes, 6 diagram types, batch CLI, and seamless integration with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI coding tools.

repos.description: 👏极客时间 pdf & markdown 文档
repos.summary_zh: 该项目聚合极客时间优质课程文档，提供 Markdown 与 PDF 双格式离线资源。核心价值在于构建可全文检索的技术知识库，支持 Docker 一键部署解决图片加载问题，并适配 PC 与移动端浏览器。基于 MkDocs-Material 主题实现优雅阅读体验，是技术人离线学习与知识管理的实用方案。
repos.summary_en: This project aggregates GeekTime's premium course documentation, offering offline Markdown and PDF resources. Its core value lies in building a full-text searchable technical knowledge base, featuring Docker deployment for image loading fixes, and responsive design for PC/mobile browsers. Powered by MkDocs-Material, it provides an elegant reading experience for developers' offline learning and knowledge management.

repos.description: CSAPP 中文文档与学习资料：《深入理解计算机系统》第三版全章节 Markdown，含练习题答案、八大实验中文翻译及官方自学实验包，方便在线阅读与离线学习。
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供《深入理解计算机系统》（CSAPP第三版）完整中文Markdown资料，涵盖全部12章正文、练习题与原书答案、附录及八大实验的中文说明与官方自学包。支持在线阅读网站（章节导航、全文搜索、深色模式）与本地离线使用，方便系统学习计算机底层原理、做题与实验实践。
repos.summary_en: Complete Chinese Markdown resources for CSAPP 3rd Edition, including all 12 chapters, practice problem answers, appendices, and Chinese translations of the eight official labs with self-study packages. Features an online reading site with navigation, full-text search and dark mode, plus offline Markdown for systematic study of computer systems, problem-solving and hands-on labs.

repos.description: 📚 Character relationship maps
repos.summary_zh: Austen是一款AI驱动的文学分析工具，通过集成DeepSeek/OpenAI自动解析书籍角色关系，并生成Mermaid可视化图谱。基于Next.js全栈框架与Supabase后端，支持用户管理、图表保存(SVG/PNG)与社交分享，为教育、阅读及文学研究提供直观的关系探索体验。
repos.summary_en: Austen is an AI-powered literary analysis tool that automatically extracts character relationships from books using DeepSeek/OpenAI and visualizes them via Mermaid diagrams. Built on Next.js fullstack with Supabase backend, it enables user management, graph export (SVG/PNG), and social sharing—ideal for educators, readers, and literary research to visually explore narrative dynamics.

repos.description: 微信读书全本导出工具 — Playwright + Canvas Hook 提取完整书籍内容为 Markdown
repos.summary_zh: 微信读书全本导出工具，通过Playwright自动化浏览器并Hook Canvas fillText方法，拦截渲染文本，结合y坐标拆分双页内容，按坐标重建段落并清理格式，导出为Markdown。适用于个人学习研究，需有效微信读书账号权限。技术亮点包括持久化登录、双页处理及文本重建，支持章节独立输出与元数据保存，解决网页版无法直接复制的问题。
repos.summary_en: weread-exporter exports complete WeRead books to Markdown by using Playwright to automate Chromium and hooking CanvasRenderingContext2D.fillText to capture canvas-rendered text. It splits double-page renders via y-coordinate detection, reconstructs paragraphs from (x,y) coordinates, and cleans formatting. Designed for personal study with valid account access, it features persistent QR login, per-chapter Markdown files, metadata JSON, and optional raw data. Addresses web version copy restrictions with ~20-30s per chapter speed.

repos.description: Markdown editor that gets out of your way. Lightweight, fast, portable. First release of https://4worlds.dev
repos.summary_zh: Inkwell是基于Rust+Tauri v2构建的轻量级Markdown编辑器，主打离线运行与极速启动（<1秒）。支持Mermaid图表、LaTeX公式、GitHub Flavored Markdown，提供4种主题与专注模式。100%本地存储，零遥测，安装包仅5-12MB。适用于跨平台写作，免费版功能完整，Pro版解锁PDF/HTML导出。
repos.summary_en: Inkwell is a sovereign Markdown editor built with Rust+Tauri v2, delivering <1s startup and offline-first operation. Features Mermaid diagrams, LaTeX math, GitHub Flavored Markdown, 4 themes, focus mode, and version history. 100% local storage, zero telemetry, 5-12MB footprint. Cross-platform for distraction-free writing. Free forever, Pro adds PDF/HTML export.

repos.description: Expert-thinking AGENTS.md profiles that teach AI agents to reason like senior scientists and engineers.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库收集503个专家级AGENTS.md配置文件，针对物理、生物、化学、工程等科学与工程领域，教导AI代理像资深从业者一样框架问题、选用工具数据库、评估证据、排查故障模式并规范报告。基于领域深度研究构建，采用开放AGENTS.md标准，兼容Cursor、Claude Code、OpenAI Codex等工具。核心价值是将通用AI转变为领域专精AI科学家，提升科研准确性与专业性，适用于数据分析、实验设计、方法起草和同行评审等场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates 503 expert AGENTS.md profiles for scientific and engineering professions, teaching AI agents to reason like senior practitioners by encoding domain-specific problem framing, tool and database selection, evidence evaluation, failure mode detection, and reporting standards. Research-grounded and built to pass field-expert validation, they leverage the open AGENTS.md standard for seamless integration with Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and other tools. The core value lies in transforming generalist AI into specialized AI scientists, enhancing precision in research workflows across physics, biology, chemistry, medicine, and engineering.
